fact: On 2026-08-11 the Justice Ministry's undersecretary said the ministry is preparing, with the digital transformation ministry, three draft laws for 2026, one of them a Data and Artificial Intelligence Regulation Law; no text or enactment is reported.
system: Data and Artificial Intelligence Regulation Law 2026 (draft)

fact: On 2026-08-06 the Council of Ministers discussed the digital transformation ministry's draft Data and Artificial Intelligence Law and directed that it be studied further before approval by the interim parliament, a joint sitting of the Sovereignty and Ministers councils.
